summary.text: Ben Sanchez is a Democratic member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from District 153, having taken office on December 1, 2018, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney, he previously served as an Abington Township commissioner from 2014 until 2019.

paragraphs.text: Sanchez was born in Abington, Pennsylvania, received a bachelor's degree from Villanova University in 1997, and earned a J.D. from Temple University School of Law in 2004.
His professional experience includes being an attorney, and he served as an Abington Township commissioner from 2014 until 2019.

In the 2023-2024 session, Sanchez was assigned to the Appropriations, Government Oversight, Health, Judiciary, Rules, and State Government committees, chairing subcommittees on Government and Financial Oversight and on Public Pensions, Benefits and Risk Management.
